price_disclaimer: Prices and calories are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and vary a lot by location (Buffalo Wild Wings is a sit-down sports bar, and wing prices move with market rates). Bundle and combo prices are the most reliable. Last updated October 2026.
intro: Buffalo Wild Wings (B-Dubs) is the sports-bar chain built around wings: traditional bone-in and boneless, tossed in more than 20 signature sauces and dry rubs from mild to the hottest Blazin'. Beyond wings there are burgers, hand-breaded tenders, loaded sides and game-day bundles, all served with big screens and beer. Wing counts come as Snack, Regular, Large and Party. Below is the full Buffalo Wild Wings menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: At Buffalo Wild Wings, 10 traditional wings with fries is about $16.99, and 20 boneless with fries is around $17.99. A la carte, a 6-wing snack is roughly $9.49 and a 10-wing order about $14.49, though prices vary a lot by location. Wings come in 20-plus sauces. A plain traditional wing is about 70 calories.
hot_deal: Buffalo Wild Wings value: Wing Tuesday and Boneless Thursday deals drop the per-wing price, and Happy Hour (Mon to Fri, 3 to 6 PM) cuts apps and drinks (mozzarella sticks $5, chips and salsa $3). Online bundles like 20 bone-in wings with fries and dips (about $21.99) are the best value for a group. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much are wings at Buffalo Wild Wings?
faqs.a: A 6-wing snack is about $9.49 and a 10-wing order around $14.49, with 10 wings and fries at about $16.99. Prices vary a lot by location since wing costs move with the market. Wing Tuesday and Boneless Thursday deals are cheaper.

faqs.q: How many sauces does Buffalo Wild Wings have?
faqs.a: Buffalo Wild Wings has more than 20 signature sauces and dry rubs, from Sweet BBQ and Honey BBQ through Medium and Mango Habanero up to the eye-watering Blazin'. Sauce is free; you just pick when you order.

faqs.q: What is the difference between traditional and boneless wings?
faqs.a: Traditional wings are classic bone-in chicken wings. Boneless wings are breaded, fried pieces of chicken breast, more like nuggets, tossed in the same sauces. Both come in Snack, Regular, Large and Party sizes.

faqs.q: How many calories are in Buffalo Wild Wings wings?
faqs.a: A plain traditional wing is about 70 calories (420 for six, 700 for ten), and ten plain boneless wings are about 730. Sauces add more, and sides like cheese curds (about 920) and mozzarella sticks (810) are heavy.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Buffalo Wild Wings?
faqs.a: The best known are the traditional wings, the boneless wings, the cheese curds, the All-American Cheeseburger, and the hand-breaded tenders, all built around the 20-plus sauces.
